name: Zeplin
description: Zeplin is a design delivery platform that separates finalized, development-ready designs from work-in-progress, generating developer specs, code snippets, and AI-powered design reviews.
best_for: Product teams and enterprises managing design systems who need clean, structured handoffs between designers and developers.
features: Automated development specs tailored to a team's tech stack
Code snippet generation from finished designs
Git-inspired version tracking of design changes
In-context annotations and requirements pinned directly to screens
Design system component and token management
AI Design Review that flags spacing, color, and accessibility inconsistencies
Integrations with Figma, Sketch, Jira, Storybook, and VS Code

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A collaborative interface design tool with real-time multiplayer editing.
alternatives.best_for: Product design teams needing collaborative UI/UX design and prototyping.

alternatives.name: Sketch
alternatives.description: A vector-based UI design tool for macOS with a large plugin ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Mac-based design teams wanting a mature, plugin-extensible design tool.

alternatives.name: Marvel
alternatives.description: A design and prototyping platform with automatic developer handoff specs.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting fast, code-free prototyping and handoff.
